note: Derivation (08-classes.md §3): every hobby CPA of the three 2025 products (data/sets @ 2226a24: 105 / 109 / 102), matched by accent-folded player name against every Chrome prospect auto list of 2019-2023 Bowman / Bowman Chrome / Bowman Draft (Cardsmiths full checklists) and 2024 Bowman / Chrome / Draft plus the 2024 Bowman and Bowman Chrome Mega Box lists (Checklist Insider; Cardsmiths also lists 2024 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autographs as 87 cards), read Oct 24-25 2026. 14 rows have an earlier auto and are firstAuto:false. Mega and Sapphire sets: all 52 Mega-only signers of the 2025 May (47 BMA- + 7 image-variation CPA-) and Sep (57 BMA- + 8 image-variation) Mega Boxes have an earlier Bowman auto (the three oldest: Mick Abel 2021 Bowman CPA-MAB, Carson Williams 2021 Bowman Draft CDA-CW, Tink Hence 2020 Bowman Draft CDA-MH); every 2025 Draft Mega signer (45) has a hobby 2025 Draft CPA (Mega est. Jan 28 2026, after hobby); the 2025 Sapphire auto sets (June 28 + 7, Chrome Sapphire 30 + 13, Draft Sapphire 30 + 15) add no new signer (Chourio, Mayer and Sasaki in Chrome Sapphire Selections are earlier-auto or rookie-auto names). Rookie autos (CRA-/RMA-) are not class rows (RCs are out, README #14). Insert and dual autos are not counted as priors (08 §1). Open, not blocking: May+Sep console coverage; pcPath null everywhere.
